submitted.rationale: Of the three merit measurements, index 30 (Bi0.10 Cu0.44 V0.46, close to a Cu:V ≈ 1:1 β-Cu2V2O7-like copper vanadate) gave the highest photocurrent, 1.78e-5 A. The Bi-rich, BiVO4-like corner (index 60) gave 1.26e-5 A, and the more Cu-rich point (index 77) dropped to 4.6e-6 A. That suggests an optimum near Cu:V ≈ 1:1.
